title: Media item deduplication is not enforced by the database

evidence.quote: guid: str = Field(description="RSS GUID for deduplication")

reasoning: Media items have separate non-unique indexes for feed id and GUID, but no composite unique constraint on (media_feed_id, guid). The model explicitly uses GUID for deduplication, yet the database still allows the same feed item to be inserted multiple times during concurrent pipeline runs or when a parsed feed contains repeated GUIDs.
reproduction: Insert two MediaItem rows with the same media_feed_id and guid; both rows are accepted because neither index is unique.
recommendation: Add a unique composite constraint/index on media_feed_id and guid, make insertion handle IntegrityError as an existing item, and migrate/clean existing duplicates before enabling the constraint.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The inspected media tests focus on retry behavior and do not assert duplicate GUID rejection or concurrent pipeline deduplication.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a media feed, attempt to add two MediaItem rows with the same media_feed_id and guid, and assert the second insert is rejected or coalesced.
minimumFixScope: MediaItem table args, media pipeline insertion error handling, and an Alembic migration for the unique composite index.
